candidate_rule: Retain every interior K6/K7-L12 local maximum whose entropy is within 0.01 kB/spin of the dense-grid maximum.

final_crosscheck: At the selected grid center, compare K6/K7 and K8/K9 with both 12 and 32 low states per parity.
scope: This selects the global peak inside the declared N=18 projection; it does not establish thermodynamic-limit convergence.
